sections.shortTitle: Azad Jammu and Kashmir Adaptation of Laws Act 1988
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

1THE AJ&K ADAPTATION OF LAWS ACT, 1988
1THE
AJ&K ADAPTATION OF LAWS ACT, 1988
AN ACT to adapt and to enforce
certain laws of Pakistan in Azad Jammu and Kashmir.
WHEREAS it is necessary to adapt and to enforce certain
laws of Pakistan in Azad Jammu and Kashmir. It is hereby enacted as follows:‑
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑--
(1) This Act may be called the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Adaptation of Laws
Act, 1988.
(2) It shall extend to the whole of Azad Jammu and Kashmir.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Azad Jammu and Kashmir Adaptation of Laws Act 1988
sections.description:
Adaptation of Laws

1THE AJ&K ADAPTATION OF LAWS ACT, 1988
1THE
AJ&K ADAPTATION OF LAWS ACT, 1988
AN ACT to adapt and to enforce
certain laws of Pakistan in Azad Jammu and Kashmir.
WHEREAS it is necessary to adapt and to enforce certain
laws of Pakistan in Azad Jammu and Kashmir. It is hereby enacted as follows:‑
2 Adaptation of Laws.--- The laws
mentioned in the schedule to this Act, and all rules made thereunder and
enforce immediately before the commencement of this Actare adapted and shall,
as far as practicable, be inforce in Azad
Jammu and Kashmir, subject to the modifications stated below:
(i) the
expressions "Government", "Federal Government",
"President" or any other expression however worded, referring to any
Executive Government, shall as far as
practicable, be construed to refer to the Azad Government of the State of Jammu
and Kashmir and reference to Pakistan or any part of Pakistan shall be
construed to refer to Azad Jammu and Kashmir;
(ii) the
expression "Provincial. Government" shall be construed to refer to
the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir.
